title: comfy generate schema <model>
description: A single partner model's callable parameters, derived from the active openapi spec. Every entry in `params` is a `--<name> <value>` flag on `comfy generate <model>`.

model.description: Preferred short alias for the model, or the endpoint id when it has none.

id.description: Canonical endpoint id (the openapi path with /proxy/ stripped).

category.description: Model style: text-to-image, image-edit, inpaint, video, … Matches the `category` field in `generate list`.

summary.description: Full one-line description from the openapi spec.

mode.description: 'async' when the partner returns a job to poll; 'sync' otherwise.

polling.description: Poller family driving the async result fetch (bfl, kling, luma, topaz), or null for sync models.

content_type.description: Request content type the proxy call uses: 'application/json' or 'multipart/form-data'.

name.description: Parameter name. The CLI flag is '--' + name.

type.description: Value type. 'enum' means `enum` below lists the only accepted values; 'binary' means a local file path streamed as multipart.

kind.description: Deprecated alias of `type`, always identical to it. Retained because it is the name the pre-envelope --json payload shipped; prefer `type`.

required.description: True when `comfy generate <model>` rejects the call without this flag.

default.description: Default applied when the flag is omitted; null when the spec declares none.

enum.description: Accepted values (e.g. output_format = ['jpeg', 'png']). Empty when the parameter is not enumerated.

description.description: Full parameter description from the openapi spec.

item_type.description: For `type` == 'array', the type of each element; null otherwise.

upload_mode.description: Set when a local file path passed to this parameter is auto-transformed before the proxy call: 'base64' inlines the bytes, 'url' uploads and substitutes a signed URL. Null means the value is sent as typed.

example.description: Copy-pasteable invocation filling every required parameter.
